name: vehicle-track coupled dynamics
definition_zh: 研究车辆与轨道相互作用及耦合振动的动力学理论。

complete_examples.text: Vehicle-track coupled dynamics Track irregularity Wheel/rail interaction Time-frequency analysis method Prediction method a b s t r a c t The dynamic performance of the railway vehicles and the guiding tracks is mainly governed by the wheel-rail interactions, particularly in cases of track irregularities.

But in the present work, an approach comprehensively developed by time-frequency analysis method and vehicle-track coupled dynamics has been investigated to further enrich the track irregularity analysis in time-frequency domain.

Based on vehicle-track coupled dynamics and finite element matrix formulation method [3, 16], the vehicle-track dynamic interaction can be unified as an entire system, as shown in Figure 1, by matrix forms M ̈X + C ̇X + KX = F (1) where M, C and K denote the mass, damping and stiffness matrices respectively; F denotes the loading vector; X, ̇X and ̈X denote the displacement, velocity and acceleration vector respectively.

As to the vehicle-track coupled dynamics model, i.e. a force coupled model, the substructural solutions are separately obtained by solving their own dynamic equations of motion, that is: The dynamic equations of motion for the vehicle system can be represented as ⎧ ⎪⎪⎪⎪⎪⎪⎪⎪⎪⎨ ⎪⎪⎪⎪⎪⎪⎪⎪⎪⎩ m1,1 ̈u1 + m1,2 ̈u2 + · · · + m1, ̄n ̈u ̄n + c1,1 ̇u1 + c1,2 ̇u2 + · · · + c1, ̄n ̇u ̄n +k1,1u1 + k1,2u2 + · · · + k1, ̄nu ̄n = F1 m2,1 ̈u1 + m2,2 ̈u2 + · · · + m2, ̄n ̈u ̄n + c2,1 ̇u1 + c2,2 ̇u2 + · · · + c2, ̄n ̇u ̄n +k2,1u1 + k2,2u2 + · · · + k2, ̄nu ̄n = F2 .
To further validate the effectiveness of the dynamic model established in this work, a vehicle-track coupled dynamics model proposed in [46] is introduced.
Currently, fruitful results have been achieved in the vehicle-track coupled dynamics [13–20].

This paper systematically proposed a long-term evolution model of train-track interaction, by implementing the elastoplastic fa tigue damage constitutive into the classical three-dimensional vehicle-track coupled dynamics.

To consider the effect of the moving vehicle or train on track vibrations and conse-quently evaluate the running performance of the vehicle, vehicle-track coupled dynamics model25 have been introduced into the complex track-tunnel-soil system in recent years.

Conclusion In this work, a train-track-mountain tunnel-rock mass dynamic interaction model is established in the framework of a finite element method, where the train and track have been coupled by the vehicle-track coupled dynamics model in finite element matrix formulations.

Based on the vehicle-track coupled dynamics theory, the calculation results between the track irregularity probabilistic model and track irregularity stochastic model was compared from the aspects of the simulated amplitude of track irregularity and the probability density distribution for dynamic response in the vehicle-track system to verify the validity and high efficacy of the track irregularity probabilistic model.

By combining the vehicle-track coupled dynamics and probability theory, a vehicle-track stochastic dynamic model in which the wheel profile wear and track random irregularities are jointly used as the excitations was developed.

Subsequently, by using vehicle-track coupled dynamics analysis and a two-dimensional interpolation operator, the dynamic response extremum was predicted based on the energy relationship of the PSD curves.

By combining the track irregularity probabilistic model and vehicle-track coupled dynamics model, the dynamic extremes and reliability information of the vehicle-track system were extracted from the stochastic analysis.
